name: pinguin-survivors-mobile
description: Capacitor shell (Android, landscape) for Penguin Survivors: loads the game build and exposes window.platform.
author: Alex Galhardo

scripts.sync: bun run prepare:web && bunx cap sync android
scripts.bundle:debug: bun run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleDebug
scripts.bundle:release: bun run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
